cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

mechanism: Copy a host's towel placement as a guest arrangement, secure tea permission, then treat the corrected household detail as approval for an overnight stay.
confusable: Not merely inviting too many guests: B2 must disclose the copied towels' purpose and A must use that misunderstanding to widen the approved visit.
comparison: A couple of relatives staying over rather than a tenants meeting claiming authority.
seedUse: Retains approved relatives for tea and gradual additional obligation; creates towel/drain misunderstanding instead of unexplained cousins.
